summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Cyber OSINT Suite. 19/19 pytest cases pass covering public APIs, telegram webhook (secret enforcement, /start user creation, no-500 on bad update), stateful OSINT tool flow (callback tool:ip -> state await:ip -> IP scan increments scans_today and inserts scans doc, state cleared), referral flow (/start 555001 credits ref_count+25 pts on referrer), CTF (solve:c2 sets state ctfflag:c2, wrong flag grants 0 pts, correct FLAG{b64_decoded} adds 60 pts + c2 in solved + ctf_submissions doc), all 8 OSINT functions return non-empty HTML, Stripe checkout success/invalid tid/unknown pkg/status, admin login/overview/users/broadcast. Frontend flows validated end-to-end: landing loads, lang-toggle switches rtl<->ltr, live stats render, pricing CTA opens checkout-modal, empty telegram id shows error, valid id triggers /api/payments/checkout, admin login with admin-osint-2026 loads dashboard with users table, /payment/success renders processing UI gracefully.

payments.get_status swallows all upstream Stripe errors silently (broad except Exception: pass) — consider logging so failed status polls are debuggable.
admin_broadcast has no rate limit / auth beyond static key; consider signed admin JWT for production.
